messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: elevated 5xx + model warmup OOMs in prod-us-west-3 for model v2.3. Triggered at 2026-03-17T02:00:20Z (auto-detected). Paging oncall.

jess (oncall): seeing a spike of 503s on /v1/generate for model_id=redwood-v2-3-quant. Root cause looks like multiple warmup pods hitting OOM while deserializing shards.

maria (runtime): confirming. Logs show failures during artifact deserialize + GPU memory alloc. Likely simultaneous warmup on scale events -> KV cache + compile spikes.

tao (sre): attaching a short log snippet:```
[2026-03-17T02:00:21Z] load_shard: deserializing shard 12 -> cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (0x7f)
[2026-03-17T02:00:21Z] warmup: failed to init kvcache; rolling back
[2026-03-17T02:00:22Z] runtime: pod OOMKilled (OOM score 0)
```

alex (eng-runtime): I can repro on a small test cluster with the same quantized artifact. Looks like the artifact's memory map + immediate compile (JIT kernels) pushes > reserved limit when multiple warmups run concurrently.

jess (oncall): current customer impact: estimated 0.8% of requests get 503s at peak, concentrated on orgs pinned to v2.3. Sam, can you confirm if any paid customers flagged support?

sam (support): Kevin from Customer Ops reported one enterprise client (acme-inc) saw intermittent failures for a subset of routes. They're on dedicated capacity but route fallback was to hosted pool that hit this. Notified account team.

maria (runtime): immediate mitigation proposal: 1) disable warmup for v2.3 on hosted pool in us-west-3, 2) throttle concurrent warmup starts (serial queue), 3) route traffic to v2.2 fallback variant for pinned customers where allowed.

tao (sre): agree. I'll push a temp autoscaler patch to delay new pod warmup by 30s when mem-pressure>70%. That should prevent stampede.

alex (eng-runtime): also recommend enabling safe-compile-guard (no JIT concurrency) for this model family until we have a patched kernel selection. Will increase latency slightly but prevents OOM.

jess (oncall): taking action now:
- @tao please deploy autoscaler delay patch to prod-us-west-3 (ACK if you got it)
- @maria toggle warmup=false for artifact redwood-v2-3-quant in hosted config
- @alex enable safe-compile-guard for v2.3 globally

tao (sre): deploying autoscaler tweak to prod-us-west-3 now. kubectl rollout restart deploy/autoscaler-usw3; watching mem metrics.

maria (runtime): toggled warmup=false for redwood-v2-3-quant in hosted-config (propagating). Will post config diff:```
- model.redwood-v2-3-quant.warmup: true
+ model.redwood-v2-3-quant.warmup: false
```

alex (eng-runtime): safe-compile-guard enabled for v2.3 via feature-flag. FFlag: runtime.safe_compile_guard.v2_3 = true

jess (oncall): observing drop in new OOMs, 5xx rate trending down from 0.8% -> 0.15% over 10m. Good. Continue to monitor for next 30m.

sam (support): updated acme-inc with temporary mitigation steps and ETA for full rollback. They asked if tokens lost — none, just 503s during warmup attempts.

kevin (customer-ops): flagged potential billing impact for affected requests. I'll coordinate credits if necessary.

maria (runtime): root-cause hypothesis: concurrent warmup + KV cache eager allocation + JIT compile causes transient memory blowout. Plan of record: 1) add startup memory reservation estimate for artifacts before warmup, 2) soft-queue warmup starts per node, 3) improve artifact deserializer to stream map instead of full mmap.

alex (eng-runtime): timeline: hotfixes (autoscaler delay + safe-compile-guard + warmup toggle) applied. Invest to fix deserializer in next sprint, estimate 2 weeks.

jess (oncall): handing off to next oncall @maria for monitoring and post-incident doc. I'm going offline in 15m. Who will own P1 follow-up doc?

maria (runtime): I'll take P1 follow-up doc and coordinate with eng-runtime. Will open an incident postmortem in #postmortems and include affected customers, timeline, and next steps.

tao (sre): I'll keep the autoscaler patch running and add a dashboard tile for warmup concurrency per-node.

sam (support): I'll update the support ticket with mitigation summary and customer-facing timeline.

jess (oncall): thanks team. current status: mitigations applied, customer impact reduced to ~0.05%, monitoring until 1745178180. Closing paging unless something new pops up. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED for alert id=warmup-oom-usw3 at 2026-03-17T02:29:40Z (resolved by jess (oncall)).
